title: Synergy of Large Model and Small Model for Port Safety Management
summary: ZTE reports that its Taicang Port system eliminated 92% of false fire alarms and detected unsafe behavior. The chapter does not establish prevented injuries.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: ZTE reports that its Taicang Port system eliminated 92% of false fire alarms and detected unsafe behavior. The chapter does not establish prevented injuries. Taicang Port deployment / 65 tests. The chapter reports the stated benefit but does not independently verify it.
purpose: Improve port risk detection while reducing false alarms.
system: ZTE Nebula hybrid port-safety vision system

ratings.reason: The deployed port system reportedly eliminated 92% of false fire positives and identified unsafe activity. This is a detection-capability gain, not proof of prevented harm.
Safer working conditions are intended; the chapter provides no injury or exposure result.
Stronger logistics resilience is intended, with no public safety effect quantified.

ai_role.statement: An edge detector flags possible fire or smoke and a larger cloud vision model checks context to reject false positives. Safety outcomes also depend on human response.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 9: Synergy of Large Model and Small Model for Port Safety Management

produced_by: Causal conditions are not established separately in the extracted chapter.
must_hold: Existing CCTV coverage with edge detection and cloud verification

headline: Port AI checks alarms and spots safety risks

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The makers' report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
